SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. 1523(C)
Date 11 / 5 / 42

S. 3. Special Branch File No.................... Date May 11. 1942.

SUBJECT: Complaint of Hungarian Association re
Enclosed Notice in the Shanghai Times
of May 2, 1942.

With reference to the attached letter from
the Hungarian Association addressed to Mr. Umemoto,
Officer-in-charge of Special Branch, making a
complaint in regard to the insertion by one Mr.
Attila Csopjak, 25 Sun Avenue, in the Shanghai Times
of May 2, 1942, of a notice, calling upon local
Hungarians to register, enquiries made ascertained
the following :-

The Hungarian Association has been established
at 209 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, Room 801 in the latter
part of 1940. It was originally formed as a
Benevolent Society for Hungarians but later its name
was changed to its present title i.e. Hungarian
Association. The chairman of the Association is
Mr. L.E. Hudec, an architect, while the vice-chairman
is one Mr. O.L. Szalay. The Hungarian Community
was very small in Shanghai, but following the
influx of many Jewish refugees from Europe, there also
arrived a number of Jewish refugees from Hungary,
with the result that more than half of the members
of the Hungarian Association are of Jewish origin.
Certain Hungarians of Aryan descent are objecting to
this policy of the Hungarian Association, and have
refused to recognise it or to register with it.
In expression of their opposition they also caused
to insert the attached notice in the Shanghai Times,
on May 2, 1942, just at a time, when the Hungarian
Minister from Tokyo was on a visit to Shanghai.

S. 3. 特务科档案编号.................... 日期 1942年5月11日。

事由：匈牙利协会就1942年5月2日《字林西报》刊登的附函启事提出投诉。

兹提及附呈之匈牙利协会致特务科主管梅本（Umemoto）先生的信函，该信就阿提拉·乔普贾克（Attila Csopjak）先生（住址：太阳路25号）在1942年5月2日《字林西报》上刊登一则号召在沪匈牙利人进行登记的启事一事提出投诉。经查询，查明情况如下：

匈牙利协会于1940年下半年在圆明园路209号801室成立。该会最初作为匈牙利人的慈善团体组建，后更名为现名，即匈牙利协会。协会主席为建筑师 L.E. 胡达克（L.E. Hudec）先生，副主席为 O.L. 萨莱（O.L. Szalay）先生。上海的匈牙利社群规模很小，但随着大量欧洲犹太难民的涌入，也有许多来自匈牙利的犹太难民抵达，导致匈牙利协会中超过半数的成员具有犹太血统。部分雅利安裔匈牙利人反对匈牙利协会的这一政策，并拒绝承认该协会或向其登记。为了表示反对，他们也在1942年5月2日的《字林西报》上刊登了所附启事，正值匈牙利驻东京公使访问上海之际。

REPORT

........................................Station. File No.................... Date....................................
____________________________________________________________________________________________________

SUBJECT: - 2 -

The article was inserted by a Mr. Attila Csopjak, a
Hungarian, who refuses to recognize the above associa-
tion and it served the object of calling the attention
of the Hungarian Minister to the policy of the above
association.

Mr. A Csopjak, 25 Sun Avenue, is a mechanical
engineer and he has been living in Shanghai for over
22 years. Although, he has no police record, Mr.
Csopjak was arrested on 24.5.39 on a charge of
receiving stolen property but was found not guilty,
and discharged. In connection with the publication
of the notice Mr. A. Csopjak was warned and advised
to refrain in the future from causing any trouble
in the ranks of the local Hungarian community,
likely disturb the peace and good order of the
Settlement.

The Shanghai Times were approached and requested
to refer notices concerning the Hungarian Community
submitted for publication by individual Hungarian
nationals to the Police or to the Hungarian Associa-
tion for information. Such a request was also made
by the Hungarian Association. The management of the
latter newspaper readily agreed to comply in the
request.

The Hungarian Association has verbally been
informed of the steps taken and they have expressed
their deep thanks for the measures taken.

E Papp
C. D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由： - 2 -

该文章由一名拒绝承认上述协会的匈牙利人阿提拉·乔普贾克（Attila Csopjak）先生刊登，其目的在于提请匈牙利公使注意上述协会的政策。

A. 乔普贾克先生，住址太阳路25号，是一名机械工程师，已在上海居住超过22年。虽然他没有警方犯罪记录，但乔普贾克曾于1939年5月24日因涉嫌收受赃物被捕，后被判定无罪并释放。就刊登启事一事，已对 A. 乔普贾克先生提出警告，并劝告其今后避免在当地匈牙利社群中制造任何可能扰乱租界和平与良好秩序的麻烦。

已接洽《字林西报》，并要求其将个人匈牙利国民提交发表的涉及匈牙利社群的启事，转交警方或匈牙利协会知悉。匈牙利协会也提出了同样的请求。该报管理层欣然同意配合这一要求。

已口头告知匈牙利协会所采取的措施，他们对所采取的措施表示了深深的感谢。

E. 帕普（E Papp）
刑事调查科
特务科主管警官。

SHANGHAI

Mr. M. Umemto, Asst. Commissioner,
In Charge S.M.P. Special Branch,
Shanghai.

Note and return.
Submit recommendation
For further report.）

Sir:

Re: Enclosed Notice which Appeared
in the Shanghai Times May 2, 1942.

Referring to the personal call which our
Chairman made this morning, and in pursuance to the
advice of Mr. Saito, we are hereby putting down in
writing our complaint and requests.

The enclosed notice has created unpleasant
repercussions in the Hungarian community, owing to
the fact that

1) approximately more than half are of
non-Aryan descent;

2) the notice appeared under the heading
"Official and Business Notices" and
implied semi-official aspect;

3) the notice has been inserted by a
person who is an unrecognized
Hungarian citizen with a police record
and has a very bad reputation in town.

Generally, the whole notice reflects on
the good name of the Hungarian community as same is
signed by such a person as described above with the
aim to cause unrest and upset the peace of the
Hungarian community.

OUR REQUEST is that the Police instruct the
Shanghai Times that before they accept such notices
which concern the Hungarian community, they shall
refer same to the Police for permission, or to the
Italian Consulate General in charge of Hungarian
interests, or to the Hungarian Association, who
officially represents the Hungarian community, and as
such has been registered with the Shanghai Municipal
Police.

主管上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科，
上海。

For further report.）

先生：

事由：关于1942年5月2日刊登在《字林西报》上的附函启事。

鉴于今早我方主席进行的私人拜访，并根据斋藤（Saito）先生的建议，我们特此书面提出我们的投诉和请求。

由于以下事实，所附启事在匈牙利社群中造成了不良反响：

1) 大约超过半数成员为非雅利安血统；

2) 该启事刊登在“官方及商业启事”栏目下，暗示了半官方的性质；

3) 该启事由一名未被认可的、有警方记录且在市内声誉极差的匈牙利公民刊登。

总体而言，整则启事损害了匈牙利社群的良好声誉，因为它是如上所述之人签署的，旨在引起动荡并破坏匈牙利社群的和平。

我们的请求是，警方指示《字林西报》，在接受涉及匈牙利社群的此类启事之前，应将其转交警方许可，或转交负责匈牙利利益的意大利总领事馆，或转交正式代表匈牙利社群并已在上海公共租界工部局警务处注册的匈牙利协会。

April 17th 1942.

Inquiry re Mr. Attila Csopjak.

Sir:

With reference to the attached report received
from the Flour Control Office requesting that the Police
conduct enquiries regarding the activities of one Attila
Csopjak suspected to be responsible for the movement of
flour.

The above person is known to the Police as A.
Csopjak alias A. Czepjit, Hungarian(C.R.D.no.3207). He
was charged with "Receiving Stolen Property" at Central
Station on the 24-5-1939, vide C.I.R.1493/39(C). At
the present time Csopjak resides in a boarding house
owned by Mrs. C. Danes, at 26 3rd Avenue, 1129 Bubbling
Well Road. He claims to be connected with the Shanghai
Iron & Steel Works, Yanch 1243, House 211, Gordon Road.

Det. Sub-Inspector I.V. Goloubkoff has conducted
enquiries regarding Csopjak, but has been unable to
connect him with any activity in either the sale or
transporting of flour since the date of receipt of the
report. It has been definitely established that flour
has not been stored in, or transported to and from his
present place of residence.

The fact that Mr. K.W. Steiner, the Flour Control
Office, had interviewed Csopjak and questioned him
regarding his activities was probably sufficient warning
to cause him to cease participating in transactions in
flour.

Copy to Special Branch
Flour Control
Office.

Detective Inspector
Senior Detective i/c.

Associate Sen.Det.1/c.
D. O. "B" Div.

关于阿提拉·乔普贾克（Attila Csopjak）先生的查询。

先生：

兹提及从面粉管制办公室收到的附呈报告，该报告请求警方对涉嫌负责面粉流动的一名阿提拉·乔普贾克（Attila Csopjak）的活动进行调查。

警方知晓上述人员为 A. 乔普贾克，化名 A. Czepjit，匈牙利人（中央注册处编号3207）。他于1939年5月24日在中央巡捕房被指控“收受赃物”，参见 C.I.R.1493/39(C)。目前，乔普贾克居住在静安寺路1129号第三大道26号由 C. 丹尼斯（C. Danes）太太拥有的寄宿公寓内。他声称与戈登路1243弄211号的上海钢铁厂有关联。

副探长 I.V. 戈卢布科夫（I.V. Goloubkoff）已对乔普贾克进行了调查，但自收到报告之日起，未能将他与任何面粉销售或运输活动联系起来。已确切证实，面粉并未储存在其当前居住地，也未从其当前居住地运进或运出。

事实上，面粉管制办公室的 K.W. 施泰纳（K.W. Steiner）先生曾面谈乔普贾克并就其活动对其进行质询，这可能足以起到警告作用，使其停止参与面粉交易。

COPY
March 5, 194?.
CONFIDENTIAL.
Dr. H. Pedersen,
Mr. Attila Csopjak, 1184/35 O'Wall Road.
The above was visited by me in company of a uniformed
Chinese Inspector from Bubbling Well Police Station at 8 a.m.
to-day and denied that he had anything to do with Flour.
I then asked the Acting Chairman of the Hungarian
Community (Mr. J.L. Szalay c/o Steiner Import Co.) what he
knew about Mr. Csopjak.
Mr. Szalay told me that this man is an engineer and
a very bad character having in the past been already involved
in many extremely doubtful transactions and has given the
Hungarian Community endless trouble.
It is possible therefore, that Mr. Csopjak is known
to the police.
May I suggest that the case be handed to the Police
and they be requested to:-
a) ascertain whether Csopjak offers Flour for sale
(Double Eagle).
b) If so, with what Movement Permits he transports
such Flour.
c) for whose account he sells the flour
d) where the flour is stored
e) to whom he has sold flour in the past.
The Hungarian Community, now representing interests of
Hungarians in Shanghai (nearest Consul in Tokyo), will assist
the Police in every way. This can be confirmed through Mr. Szalay.
The man was denounced to me by Kiessling & Bader on the
strict understanding that their name MUST NOT be used in connection
with this case. I promise this. Could the Police please be in-
formed accordingly.
Mr. Lees this morning told me that he would like you to
write in officially giving full details of what is required.
For information and instructions please.
K. M. Steiner.

副本
194?年3月5日。
机密。
致 H. 佩德森（H. Pedersen）博士，
阿提拉·乔普贾克（Attila Csopjak）先生，奥威尔路（O'Wall Road）1184/35号。
今天上午8点，我在静安寺巡捕房一名华籍巡长的陪同下拜访了上述人员，他否认自己与面粉有任何关系。
随后，我询问了匈牙利社群代理主席（J.L. 萨莱（J.L. Szalay）先生，转施泰纳进口公司）关于乔普贾克先生的情况。
萨莱先生告诉我，此人是一名工程师，品行极劣，过去曾卷入许多极其可疑的交易，给匈牙利社群带来了无尽的麻烦。
因此，乔普贾克先生可能为警方所知。
我建议将此案移交警方，并请他们：-
a) 查明乔普贾克是否出售面粉（双鹰牌）。
b) 如果是，他使用何种移动许可证运输此类面粉。
c) 他代表谁销售面粉
d) 面粉储存在何处
e) 他过去向谁出售过面粉。
目前代表在沪匈牙利人利益（最近的领事馆在东京）的匈牙利社群，将在各方面协助警方。这一点可通过萨莱先生确认。
基斯林和巴德（Kiessling & Bader）向我举报了此人，但严格约定他们的名字绝不得与此案有任何关联。我承诺遵守这一点。能否请相应地通知警方。
利斯（Lees）先生今天早上告诉我，他希望您正式写信，详细说明所需内容。
供阅知及指示。
K. M. 施泰纳（K. M. Steiner）。
